text: Agents dynamically join and leave a running cluster (peers, hive state, leader fallback update without restarting the others).
The replica cap N is set at cluster init (ClusterSpec field, ceiling 16); the leader can scale between 1 and N with a tool.
Scaling can be disabled per cluster (static cluster). Static with 1 pod = no hive, peers or messaging tools.
One shared orchestrator any-mcp plugin carries every agent-to-orchestrator tool, including scale; built by hive-mode-leadership-handove, this epic adds the scale route and its allow rule.
Headless parity: every UI capability (cap, static, replicas) has a documented public API and an API-only e2e test.
The first ready agent leads when a hive starts; scaling up never hands leadership to a joining agent.
Handover only, no takeovers: a scale-down never removes the leader and only the leader may scale through the tool.
Tools on load hint the mode; a static single-pod cluster gets no hive, peers or messaging tools (the agent is alone), so no scale tool either.
Releases, bumps and the helmfile apply and smoke are tasks of this epic.
